changelog:
Instagram content marketing skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generate engaging Instagram content packages from e-commerce product URLs (Amazon, Shopify, Taobao, etc.)
- Extracts product details via SkillBoss API Hub or manual workflow
- Outputs ready-to-post ideas: image/video briefs, captions with CTAs, optimized hashtag sets, and posting strategy
- Includes multiple content frameworks (fashion, tech, lifestyle, etc.) and template structures (feed, carousel, story, reel)
- Provides actionable best practices, engagement triggers, and references for campaign planning and hashtag optimization
